A '''temple''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Syngia]] was used by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Remulus Dreypa]] during his experiments with [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], and he left behind a [[genesis pool]] in the temple; the pool was still intact during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, though the temple was in ruins.
